notes:
Topline: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated. Initial POC used hosted API for in-app support chat and contextual doc search. Strong cost sensitivity; primary asks: p95 latency <250ms for chat, sustained throughput ~150-250 rps for search embeddings, predictable unit economics for forecasting.

Highlights from calls/workshops:
- 2026-02-28 demo (Fireflies ff_2026-02-28_cedarway-demo): showed hosted API integration with product web widget, streaming enabled, ephemeral KV cache for session context. Customer quote: "latency looks good, but tokens are driving cost — need levers."
- 2026-03-05 security deep-dive: SSO/SAML flows and SOC2 checklist review; asked for KMS/HSM options and audit log retention policy. Drive security doc updated (drive:/security/cedarway-security-answers-2026-03-05.docx).
- 2026-03-09 cost optimization workshop (remote): Redwood SE presented batching/caching/quant profiles. Agreed to run two side-by-side POC tracks: hosted with optimized batching + prefix caching, and Dedicated with 4-bit quantized models. Key takeaway: batching + cache reduces token spend by ~30-55% on conversational flows in our sim, quantization reduces GPU cost by ~40% on heavy embedding pipelines.

POC details / technical notes:
- Workload: mixed chat + embeddings + reranking for feature flags and search ordering.
- Latency SLO: p95 <250ms for chat; bulk embed jobs can be async.
- Throughput target: 150-250 rps for doc-search endpoints; occasional spikes to 600 rps during releases.
- Model preferences: open Llama-variant initially; willing to evaluate family drift to Redwood-verified models for cost profile.
- Caching strategy: session-level KV cache + prefix cache for docs. Want TTL controls by route.
- Batching: target micro-batching window 10-25ms for chat, larger for embeddings. Need Redwood suggestions re: batching policy per route.
- Quantization: prefer testing q4_0/q4f16 for inference; request Redwood quant profile recommendations and benchmarks on V100 vs A100.

Commercial / purchasing notes:
- Interested in starting hosted POC under free credits then move to a 6mo Dedicated pilot if unit economics justify. Procurement expects a clear monthly cost model and a cap for burst.
- Estimated ARR if deployment is successful: $75k-200k (see estimated_arr_range).
- Pricing sensitivity: willing to trade margin for predictable committed capacity (Reserved/Dedicated).

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If we can knock 30% off token costs with caching/batching and keep latency under 250ms, Dedicated makes sense." — Head of Product
- "We need an answer on data residency and audit logs before legal signs off." — Security Lead
